It says it is based in Metro Detroit with service in AZ, CO, FL, IL, IN, MI, NV, NY, TN, TX and DC.

Reel ClqxD0UjSbJ caption: 'Sneak peak into a magnificent property we shot yesterday 🥂 Builder: @lamarcohomes Architect: @martinisamartinodesigngroup'. Feed posts are shoots of client properties, with builder, architect and agent credits.
Reel DVYna7xjmAK credits 'Builder: @hbdbuilder / Outdoor Design: @pjelawncare'. wayupmedia.com names 'PJE Lawn Care & Landscaping' among its clients.

Reels Coh1BTUD6jx ('Architect: @azdarchitects') and DWjLuOqjin8 ('nominated for Home of the Year! ... check out @azdarchitects & @nastructures bio and vote entry #19'). wayupmedia.com names 'AZD Architects' among its clients.
Reel DPTscmgDrm6 caption: 'Does the peace and privacy here make $7.9M worth it? ... Agent: @a_team_telluride_real_estate'. Listing tour crediting the listing agent.

The Linktree 'Apply to join our influencer network' form asks about prior 'sponsored house tours or real estate features' and how the applicant would feature 'one of our properties'. This shows WayUp recruits creators for sponsored property features.

Website self-claims, not independently verified: 'Most Followed Real Estate Media Company in The U.S.', '1.9M+ social media followers, 50M+ monthly views, 25K new followers monthly, 10K+ satisfied clients'.

content_mode_evidence: Earlier cover coding of DPTscmgDrm6 and DVYna7xjmAK (repo data/processed/reels_cover_coded.csv) found real_existing / real_footage ('drone footage of a real listed property', 'real camera footage at dusk'). Captions credit real builders, architects and listing agents and name prices ($7.9M) and places (Telluride). The company sells FPV drone and videography shoots. Virtual staging/twilights is offered as a service, but it was not seen in the sampled feed posts.
niche_focus: US luxury home and mansion tours (drone/FPV, exteriors, backyards, pools) shot for builders, architects and realtors by a Michigan-based real-estate media and social agency.
cta_pattern: Engagement questions ('Would you live here??', 'How much is this home is worth??', 'Does ... make $7.9M worth it?'); relationship tag-bait ('Tag her in the comments to see if you got it right', 'Tag the first person...'); credit block (Builder/Architect/Agent/Interior Design @handles); occasional vote CTA; short hashtag set (#luxuryhomes #realestate #mansion). Bio sends traffic to a Linktree with service leads, an influencer-network form and careers.

notes: WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted (200/200), so the Instagram-snippet, paid-partnership and storefront searches and the 3 reel-sample searches did not run. Evidence points to money coming mainly from client shoots (builders, architects, realtors), social media management and an influencer network for sponsored property features, not from affiliate storefronts. No Amazon, LTK or ShopMy storefront, digital products or courses were seen. The Instagram 'Paid partnership' label was not checked (UNKNOWN). No third-party income estimate was found.
